sources.title: System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers
sources.titleEn: System Noise-Figure Analysis for Modern Radio Receivers
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Friis 自由空間：天線距離倍增損耗
related.titleEn: Friis free space: loss from doubling antenna distance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 2.4 linear noise factor 與 2.04 linear noise factor，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 2.4 linear noise factor and 2.04 linear noise factor, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋6.02059991328 dB與12.0411998266 dB，建立distance_budget.csv、功率比例驗算、傳播假設清單，並完成以下驗收：剩餘鏈路餘裕若小於12.04 dB，不接受4 km方案；此結論限遠場與相同極化假設。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 6.02059991328 dB and 12.0411998266 dB; create distance_budget.csv, power-ratio checks and propagation assumptions; apply this acceptance decision: Reject the 4 km plan if remaining margin is below12.04 dB; the conclusion requires far-field and unchanged polarization assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 限匹配的同頻雙埠級聯，Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1；所有F與G用線性功率比，不把此簡式套入未處理鏡像的混頻器。 展開基準式 2+(5-1)/10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先以後級貢獻0.4與0.04逐項相加，再轉dB；確認極大G1極限趨近F1。 將兩條推導一起存入 noise_cascade.csv、線性/dB對照、壓縮排除證據。
從原理 遠場自由空間接收功率與距離平方成反比；額外路徑損耗為20log10(d2/d1)，不包含遮蔽與多徑。 展開基準式 20*log10(2)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：在線性域用1/4與1/16功率比反算dB；確認兩次距離倍增的損耗可相加。 將兩條推導一起存入 distance_budget.csv、功率比例驗算、傳播假設清單。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For matched same-frequency two-port stages, Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1 using linear power ratios; do not apply the shortcut to an untreated mixer image band., expand baseline expression 2+(5-1)/10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Add downstream contributions 0.4 and 0.04 independently, then convert to dB; the large-G1 limit must approach F1. Save both derivations with noise_cascade.csv, linear/dB conversions and compression counterevidence.

Starting from Far-field free-space received power scales as inverse distance squared; added loss is 20log10(d2/d1), excluding blockage and multipath., expand baseline expression 20*log10(2); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Convert power ratios 1/4 and 1/16 to dB independently; two distance doublings must add in dB. Save both derivations with distance_budget.csv, power-ratio checks and propagation assumptions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HSDPA HARQ：重傳機會與平均交付時間
related.titleEn: HSDPA HARQ: retries and mean delivery time
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 2.4 linear noise factor 與 2.04 linear noise factor，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 2.4 linear noise factor and 2.04 linear noise factor, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋4.44444444444 ms與5.33333333333 ms，建立harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表，並完成以下驗收：5 ms平均門檻下第二組失敗；平均通過仍不能保證尾延遲或有上限重傳的成功率。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 4.44444444444 ms and 5.33333333333 ms; create harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings; apply this acceptance decision: The second case fails a5 ms mean limit; a passing mean does not establish tail latency or bounded-retry reliability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 限匹配的同頻雙埠級聯，Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1；所有F與G用線性功率比，不把此簡式套入未處理鏡像的混頻器。 展開基準式 2+(5-1)/10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先以後級貢獻0.4與0.04逐項相加，再轉dB；確認極大G1極限趨近F1。 將兩條推導一起存入 noise_cascade.csv、線性/dB對照、壓縮排除證據。
從原理 本課用獨立失敗機率p的簡化停止等待模型E[N]=1/(1-p)；實際軟合併使各次失敗率相關，須另外量測。 展開基準式 4/(1-0.1)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把前十項幾何級數與解析極限比較，保留未加總尾項；不要把p直接當平均重傳次數。 將兩條推導一起存入 harq_attempts.csv、級數尾項、回饋時間表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from For matched same-frequency two-port stages, Ftotal=F1+(F2-1)/G1 using linear power ratios; do not apply the shortcut to an untreated mixer image band., expand baseline expression 2+(5-1)/10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Add downstream contributions 0.4 and 0.04 independently, then convert to dB; the large-G1 limit must approach F1. Save both derivations with noise_cascade.csv, linear/dB conversions and compression counterevidence.

Starting from Use a simplified stop-and-wait model with independent failure probabilityp and E[N]=1/(1-p); real soft combining changes conditional failure rates., expand baseline expression 4/(1-0.1); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compare ten terms of the geometric series with its analytic limit and retain the tail; p is not the mean retry count. Save both derivations with harq_attempts.csv, series-tail checks and feedback timings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
